hero.subtitle: A massive colonization initiative to establish a ring of inhabited systems across the Milky Way, connecting the Bubble to the farthest frontiers.

about.title: Mission Briefing
about.subtitle: The Galaxy Ring Project aims to create a continuous chain of colonized systems forming a ring around the galactic center.
about.p1: Commanders, the Galaxy Ring Project calls upon all explorers, miners, traders, and fighters to participate in one of the most ambitious colonization efforts in human history.
about.p2: Our goal is to establish outposts and settlements in a continuous ring pattern, creating safe corridors through the void and connecting distant regions to the inhabited bubble.
about.feature1: Explore uncharted systems and claim new worlds
about.feature2: Establish mining operations and supply chains
about.feature3: Defend expansion zones from hostile threats
about.feature4: Map optimal routes through dangerous sectors

join.title: Join The Expedition
join.subtitle: Becoming part of the Galaxy Ring Project is simple. Follow these steps to enlist.

step1.title: Register
step1.desc: Join our Discord and register your CMDR name in the project database.

step2.title: Get Assigned
step2.desc: Receive your designated sector and route assignment from command.

step3.title: Explore
step3.desc: Travel to your assigned systems, scan, and prepare for colonization.

step4.title: Colonize
step4.desc: Deploy surface bases, establish supply lines, and claim the void.

faq.title: Command Database
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions from pilots considering joining the expedition.
faq.a1: Any ship can contribute! Explorers may use Asp Explorers or Anacondas for long-range jumps, while miners and traders can operate closer to established outposts. Even a Sidewinder can scout nearby systems.
faq.a2: Engineered FSD is recommended for deep space sectors (50+ LY jump range), but many ring segments are accessible with stock ships. We have carriers that can ferry ships to distant staging points.
faq.a3: Use the EDSM sync feature or submit system scans through our Discord bot. Command tracks all contributions and updates the galactic map in real-time.
faq.a4: While there are no in-game rewards from Frontier, the project maintains internal rankings, badges, and recognition for top contributors. Your name will be recorded in the expedition logs.
faq.a5: Several planned route segments pass near or through Thargoid-controlled regions. Combat wings are assigned to protect colonization fleets. Check the locked regions map before plotting your course.
